title: tenant-aware pre-upgrade canary + cron cert-init hooks for private deployment charts
author: Imani Reyes
description: Context: Private deployments need safer, tenant-scoped upgrade paths and unattended certificate bootstrapping for air-gapped clusters. This PR adds tenant-aware Helm hook templates and a lightweight cron-style cert-init job so on-prem installations can perform predictable canary upgrades and automated certificate rotation/bootstrap without operator intervention. It updates the values.schema.json to allow per-tenant hook config, introduces a new hooks/_tenant-hooks.tpl subtemplate used by all private subcharts, and adds a pre-upgrade canary weighting mechanism plus a post-failure rollback job. Motivation: current private installer upgrades operate cluster-wide and block on manual checks; tenants required a way to opt into staged rollouts and autonomous cert initialization for sealed-secret-based KMS setups. Changes: 1) values.schema.json: new properties "tenants" and "tenantHooks" with validation for per-namespace hook enablement and canaryWeight (0-100). 2) templates/hooks/_tenant-hooks.tpl: shared helper that renders pre-upgrade canary Job, post-upgrade rollback Job, and cert-init CronJob when enabled. 3) templates/webhook-deploy.yaml & templates/worker-deploy.yaml: minor annotations to opt into tenant hooks and to reference tenant-scoped serviceaccounts. 4) templates/preflight-configmap.yaml: move lightweight preflight checks for network/CNI to a configmap that's consumed by hook jobs. 5) chart/README.md: documented tenant-scoped upgrade flow and example values for multi-tenant clusters and air-gapped environments. Compatibility: default behavior is opt-out; existing values continue to work. Deployment notes: when enabling per-tenant hooks, administrators must create a Tenant CR (or map via values.tenants) with kube namespace mapping for the hooks to target. See examples in README.
commit_summary: a1b2c3d: add values.schema.json entries for tenants and tenantHooks with JSON schema and examples
d4e5f6a: add templates/hooks/_tenant-hooks.tpl to centralize hook rendering and tenant scoping
b7c8d9e: wire tenant annotations into webhook and worker deployments and make serviceAccount optional
e0f1a2b: add cert-init CronJob template and small utility script used in the job image (script only referenced)
f3a4b5c: update chart README with tenant upgrade guide and air-gap notes
c6d7e8f: add unit tests for values schema and helm template rendering in CI
review_comments: Arjun: Can the canaryWeight be overridden per-deployment when tenants share the same cluster? Please ensure the validation prevents >100 values.
Author (Imani): Yes, schema enforces integer 0-100 and chart merges use priority: tenant-level -> global -> default.
Maeve: We should avoid creating RBAC privileges broader than the target namespace. Confirmed the hook renders namespaced rolebindings only.
Diego: CI helm-unittest failed once for missing default values; added test fixtures and re-ran. All green now.
Ops (post-merge): Remember to update private-installer to pass tenants map via --set when bootstrapping in air-gapped installs.
release_notes: Added tenant-scoped Helm hooks and a CronJob-based cert-init for private deployments. New values.tenants and values.tenantHooks allow per-namespace canary rollouts (canaryWeight) and automated certificate bootstrap/rotation. Backwards compatible; opt-in.
